basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old tech enthusiast from Buenos Aires, Argentina. My passion lies in gaming and building custom mechanical keyboards. I work as a software developer during the day, which allows me to blend my love for technology with my profession. During my free time, I enjoy experimenting with new gaming setups and trading in-game items. I'm single and enjoy spending my late evenings online, usually between 9 PM to 2 AM local time, after a long day at work. I also dabble in home studio recording, which ties into my love for music.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the software industry for over a decade. My expertise in technology is both academically grounded and practically honed through years of hands-on experience. I frequently engage with online communities to stay updated on the latest trends and technologies.
